## Ctx.inlineKeyboardT() method

Creates an inline keyboard with template-based buttons linked to page destinations.

**Signature:**

```typescript
inlineKeyboardT(PageDest: IKbDest[], layout?: IKbCols, baseId?: string | null, data?: Record<any, any>): InlineKeyboard;
```

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Optional template base ID. IMPORTANT: If a `<base id="...">` is defined in the template, you must set baseId to the same value. Leaving baseId as undefined in this case will cause errors (for example, keyboard bindings will not work). A common mistake is defining a base ID in the template but not reusing it in the keyboard configuration.


</td></tr>

**Returns:**

InlineKeyboard

The inline keyboard instance.

## Remarks

Shorthand for [Ctx.inlineKeyboard()](./gramstax.ctx.inlinekeyboard.md) with automatic callback data from page destinations.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  const kb = this.inlineKeyboardT([SettingsPage, HelpPage], "2")
  await this.reply(kb)

  // Or with payload
  const kb = this.inlineKeyboardT([SettingsPage.data.callback(1), HelpPage.data.callback(`hi`)], "2")
  await this.reply(kb)

  // Compare with builder for basic but not recomended because very long syntax, only use builder when needed.!
  this.inlineKeyboard((k, a) => k.text(SettingsPage.data.callback(), a[0]!).text(HelpPage.data.callback(), a[1]!))
}
```
